The ribonucleoprotein particle is the signal recognition particle (SRP). It recognizes an ER-targeting signal sequence on the nascent polypeptide as it emerges from a cytosolic ribosome, pauses translation, and delivers the complex to the rough ER. “Sugar” points to N-linked glycosylation in the secretory pathway. After ER/Golgi processing, the protein is typically secreted outside the cell.

Answer: C
